inventory_metadata.stack: Vite + React 19 + React Router 7 + Tailwind 4 browser mock
known_limitations: No runtime UI verification; runtime_verified is null for all routes.
Navigate to /login for unknown roles has no dedicated Route.
Root path / redirect differs by workspace (Super Admin vs Brand Partner subtree).
Only valid brand section slugs from brand/nav.js menu are enumerated.
Per-route page content not fully deep-audited in this generator pass.
Content enrichment applied from ModulePage catalogue, specialized page sources, and Brand page copy objects
Appendices super_admin_appendix and brand_workspace_appendix hold deeper page inventories for Excel expansion
